book.name: 1 Kolɛŋ
book.title: Ŋwa wù fwe wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki Kolɛŋ le

content: Bamii ba Kletu nyûme jwe wu mumwaa

Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, sege besabɛŋ gɛ̀ bee, gɛ ŋgɛ̀ taŋlo njɛme bɛŋ le njɛ bamii ba yuge wa nyume Kiyo ki Yuude le gɛ. Ŋgɛ̀ njɛme bɛŋ le njɛ bamii ba baaŋ bo bii nyume mwɛɛ mù nyaŋ yi ye goone le, mo ba baaŋ njɛ mumwone mu mbwele yi Kletu le.
Ŋgɛ̀ nnyaa nyume ambɛŋ bɛŋ le. Ŋgɛ̀ baaŋ nnya gɛ mwɛɛ munjile mù tɛɛme gɛ, nje bɛŋ gɛ̀ baaŋ a ta gɛ. Mo too bude mɛɛse bɛŋ baaŋ a ta gɛ.

Bɛŋ baaŋ bɛŋ bii gɛh nyume mwɛɛ mù nyaŋ yi ye goone le. No bɛŋ baaŋ bɛŋ ghɛge kiŋghɛ, bɛŋ waade waa a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ, tu gɛ finɛ fiɛɛ duunyi lɛ bɛŋ bii nyume nyaŋ yi ye le gɛ? Gɛ finɛ fiɛɛ duunyi lɛ bɛŋ baaŋ bɛŋ kɛme gee chi bamii ba fɛkuu fɛnɛ gɛ?
Muh jade wu duu lɛ wu bii nyume Bol le, muh mu lɛ wu bii fie nyume Abolo le, tu gɛ finɛ fiɛɛ duunyi lɛ bɛŋ gee nyume gee chi bamii ba fɛkuu fɛnɛ gɛ?
Abolo le yɛɛŋ, Bol nyume yɛɛŋ? Bee bachii le gɛh lo booŋ ba lɛme ba Tada ba gɛ̀ fɛ, fɛ bɛŋ leesɛ fitele yi ye ye le, muh lɛne che lɛme no Tada nya wu le.
Chaŋ lɛme gɛ̀ bee lɛ mbooŋ nyume ŋgo, chi Abolo le, nfuushɛ joo, geenɛ, gee Nyo fɛ yi kûu.
Noo, gɛ muh wù boone ŋgo bɛ muh wù fuushi joo kooji fiɛɛ gɛ. Le gɛh Nyo maa wù gee fɛ yi kûu.
Muh wù mbonɛ bɛ wù nfuushɛ joo le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ, Nyo lé wu gê wu mâajɛ muh wuchii bii yi lɛme che le.
Bee le be taashɛ bee lɛne lɛme chi Nyo. Bɛŋ mo bɛŋ nyume mwɛ wù Nyo bɛŋ ka nyume yeh ye.

Mo no ŋgɛ̀ nleesɛ kichi ki yeh yiyu njɛ muh wù njonɛ wù kee lɛme che chuule mbii nfii wù Nyo gɛ̀ nya mɛne. No ŋgɛ̀ nleesɛ noo, muh mu mo wu joone yeh yiyu. Noo sege muh joone yi kichi kinɛ le, wu mo wu kêe no wu joone.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ kichi mɛ gɛh kì ba gɛ̀ leesɛ wa kì le Jiso Kletu, gɛ taŋlo muh ka wu leesɛ kimi gɛ.

Bamii mo bo tu bo joone yi kichi kiyu le bɛ mwɛɛ yeye yeye. Muh mu ja wu jo nyume kichwa kì yɛɛde, muh mu jo kì baaŋ, muh mu jo ata a tɛɛme fɛ wu joone yu. Muh mu jo nyume bite, muh mu agaaŋ, muh mu jégɛ fɛ wu jôone yu.

Bo nɛ joone nɛɛ, tu juu too lo chì bo lé bo gê bo yɛ̂ŋ no lɛme chi muh le, sege chi bu fɛ waaŋ Juu chì Kletu lé wu gê wu tôo bɛ ŋgu, ŋgu wuyu lé wu gê wu mône lɛme chi muh, ba yɛde no chi le.
Nɛ fiɛɛ fì muh wu joone yi kichi kiyu le mɛ gɛh njɛ fi fie sɛŋ, mwɛdɛ mo wu kɛ̂mɛ maajɛ.
Nɛ fi fie lo, mwɛdɛ lɛ̂sɛ maajɛ we, wu bɛ kikwɛɛ ke bônɛ, geenɛ gɛh njɛ muh wù fe yi ŋgu le.
Bamii ba Kletu le yeh yi kintanyɛ yi Nyo
Gɛ bɛŋ kee lɛ bɛŋ le yeh yi kintanyɛ yi Nyo, Kiyo ke ki wu wù Nyo chêe yi ye yene le gɛ?
Nɛ muh chɛŋe bɛ yeh yiyu, tu Nyo le wu lɛ̂ɛshɛ lo mwɛdɛ, nje yeh yi kintanyɛ yi Nyo yuude lo, bɛŋ nyume yeh yiyu.
Keefɛ muh lɛ̂ɛde bɛ kikwɛɛ ke gɛ. Nɛ muh mu bɛŋ le kwaji lɛ wu kɛme bvufee yi woŋ kfunɛ le, wu tu kiyuŋ wu lɛ wu kɛ̂me bvufee bvù bvufee.
Njɛme nɛ nje mwɛɛ mù bamii ba fɛkuu fɛnɛ yɛde lɛ le bvufee, Nyo yɛde lɛ le kiyuŋ. Le fi fì ba gɛ̀ saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Nyo jode gɛh nyume bvufee bvu bamii ba feefe,

content: Fi ka nyume ba saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Tada kee lɛ mwɛɛ mù bamii ba bvufee kwaji,

content: Fi tu fi nyume lɛ, keefɛ muh chîaase ye lɛ muh mu le we gɛ, nje mwɛɛ munchii le mwɛna.
Bol kɛnɛ Abolo kɛnɛ Sɛfa kɛnɛ woŋ kfunɛ kɛnɛ kinche kɛnɛ kwe kɛnɛ mwɛɛ mu mɛɛse kɛnɛ mu baaŋ ki mu gê mu nyume, le mwɛna munchii,
bɛŋ le ba Kletu, Kletu nyume wu Nyo.
